title: Luxuriant Garlicky Vietnamese Noodles
description: Indulge in the rich flavors of Vietnam with this garlicky noodle dish, featuring bay leaves and a creamy pasta-water emulsion, served on a bamboo tray.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to package instructions.
In a blender or food processor, combine garlic, bay leaves, and vegetable oil, and blend until smooth.
In a large skillet, heat the blended garlic mixture over medium heat and cook for 2 minutes.
Add soy sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a small bowl, whisk together pasta water and eggs, and add to the skillet, stirring constantly to create a creamy emulsion.
Add cooked noodles to the skillet and toss to combine with the garlic sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve on a bamboo tray.
